response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong software craftsmanship and some high-throughput systems exposure, but falls well short of the core requirements. The role demands 8 years of C++ and deep large-scale infrastructure/compute platform experience; the resume shows only ~7 months of professional C++ work, a career centered on web/product development in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, and no formal technical-leadership or people-mentoring role at the level described.
strengths: Low-latency distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second
Broad, long-tenured engineering background with strong testing/TDD culture and open-source contributions
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (roughly 7 months professionally)
No formal technical-lead or mentoring-of-cloud/DevOps-engineers role; career track is senior IC in product engineering
Limited large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure architecture experience; background skews toward web and product development

key_factors.factor: Lack of technical leadership track record
